inputs.text: [excited] It was 0.5 meters long — [quickly] like a big cat stretched out! Standing up, it was only 0.3 meters tall — it would come up to your knees! And it weighed barely 1 kilo — [gently] light as a small bird.
[curious] That small, could it really fly?
[hesitant] Scientists still debate it. [gently] It had real flight feathers, but maybe it flew poorly, or only over short distances.
